cards.text:
地相技师行动
地相干扰 1AP
选择一个地形模型上的一个点，那个点必须位于
这名特工 8" 内且可见的位置。为那个点 2" 内的
每一名特工分别进行 2D6 掷骰。若掷骰结果高
于那名特工剩余的耐伤，则那名特工受到等同于
两者差值的伤害。
这名特工不能在拥有隐匿命令以及位于敌方特工
的控制范围内时执行此行动。
控制冥工 1AP
支援。选择对这名特工可见且位于其 6" 内的一
名己方冥工之环特工。您还可以选择对这名特
工可见且位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内的一名己
方冥工之环特工（支援不适用这个选项）作为
替代。那名被选择的特工可以执行一个无消耗
的 1 AP 行动；但在那次行动中不能移动超过 2"
，在被移除并重新部署时也必须完全位于原位
置 2" 内。
这名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此
行动。
cards.text_en:
GEOMANCER ACTIONS
GEOMANTIC DISTURBANCE 1AP
Select a point on a terrain feature; that point must be visible
to and within 8" of this operative. Separately roll 2D6 for
each operative within 2" of that point. If the result is higher
than that operative’s remaining wounds, inflict damage on it
equal to the difference.
This operative cannot perform this action while it has
a Conceal order, or while within control range of an
enemy operative.
CANOPTEK CONTROL 1AP
SUPPORT. Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
CANOPTEK operative visible to and within 6" of this
operative. Alternatively, you can select one friendly
CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative that’s
visible to this operative and within your OBELISK NODE
MATRIX (SUPPORT doesn’t apply to this selection). That
selected operative can immediately perform a 1AP action
for free; it cannot move more than or be removed and set up
more than 2" during that action.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative, or while counteracting.

cards.text:
地相技师行动
分子突破 1AP
支援。选择对这名特工可见且位于其 6" 内的一
名己方冥工之环特工。您还可以选择对这名特
工可见且位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内的一名己
方冥工之环特工（支援不适用这个选项）作
为替代。
下一次被选择的特工执行移动的行动时，不要移
动它。作为替代，将其从杀戮区移除，并将其部
署在从原先位置起完全位于等同于其移动属性范
围内的位置（如果行动是冲刺则为 3"），在此过
程中只需测量水平距离（在使用近距离战斗规则
的杀戮区中，例如杀戮区：墓穴世界，这类测距
可以穿过墙壁地形，并且特工可以被放置在其对
面）。请注意，这不会在其执行冲锋行动时增加
距离。它必须被部署在可以被放置的位置，并且
除非执行的是冲锋行动，不然它不能被放置在一
名敌方特工的控制范围内。
这名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此
行动。
cards.text_en:
GEOMANCER ACTIONS
MOLECULAR BREACH 1AP
SUPPORT. Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
operative visible to and within 6" of this operative.
Alternatively, you can select one friendly CANOPTEK
CIRCLE operative visible to this operative and within your
OBELISK NODE MATRIX (SUPPORT doesn’t apply to
this selection).
The next time the selected operative performs an action in
which it moves, don’t move it. Instead, remove it from the
killzone and set it back up wholly within a distance equal
to its Move stat (or 3" if it was a Dash) horizontally of its
original location (in a killzone that uses the close quarters
rules, e.g. Killzone: Tomb World, this distance can be
measured over and through Wall terrain and the operative
can be set up on the other side). Note that it gains no
additional distance when performing the Charge action. It
must be set up in a location it can be placed, and unless it’s
the Charge action, it cannot be set up within control range
of an enemy operative.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

OVERCHARGE 1AP
Select one other friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
CANOPTEK operative visible to and within 3" of this
operative. Alternatively, if this operative is within your
OBELISK NODE MATRIX, you can select one other
friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK operative
within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX. Until the end
of that selected operative’s next activation, add 1 to its
APL stat.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control

CRANIAL OVERLOAD 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to and within 3" of
this operative. Alternatively, if this operative is within your
OBELISK NODE MATRIX, you can select one enemy
operative within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX. Until
the end of that enemy operative’s next activation, subtract 1
from its APL stat.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative.

cards.text:
APL 移动豁免耐伤
冥工重生巨虫
2 7" 4+ 7
重生：每个转折点一次，当另一名己方冥工之环
特工将被残废时，如果那名特工位于这名特工 6"
内且可见，或这名特工以及那名特工均位于己方方
尖碑节点矩阵内，且双方都不位于敌方特工控制范
围内，您便可以使用这个规则。若此，那名己方特
工不会残废且剩余 1 点耐伤，并且直到行动结束前
不能被残废。在那次行动后，那名己方特工可以立
即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但必须在己方方尖
碑节点矩阵控制范围内结束那次行动，并将那些特
工的 APL 属性在各自的下一次激活结束前减去 1
点，并且若这个规则在那名特工的激活中使用，则
那次激活结束。您不能在这名特工残废时，或者在
该特工被选择成为一次射击行动的主要或次要目标
时使用这个规则。
纳米甲虫光束 1AP
选择位于这名特工 6" 内且可见的另一名己方冥
工之环特工。若这名特工位于己方方尖碑节点
矩阵内，则您可以选择位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵
内的另一名己方冥工之环特工作为替代。被选
择的特工恢复失去的 3D3 点耐伤。本技能不能
以在同一个转折点中使用了“重生”规则的己方
特工为目标，在每个转折点中执行本行动的次数
不能超过一次。
这名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此
行动。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
CANOPTEK MACROCYTE REANIMATOR
2 7" 4+ 7
Reanimate: Once per turning point, when another friendly
CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative would be incapacitated,
if that operative is visible to and within 6" of this operative, or
if this and that operative are within your OBELISK NODE
MATRIX, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that
operative is within control range of an enemy operative. If you
do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound
remaining and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the
action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately
perform a free Dash action, but must end that action within
this operative’s control range or within your OBELISK NODE
MATRIX. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats
until the end of their next activations respectively, and if this
rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that
activation ends. You cannot use this rule if this operative is
incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would
be a primary or secondary target.
NANOSCARAB BEAM 1AP
Select one friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative
visible to and within 6" of this operative. Alternatively, if this
operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, you
can select one other friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
operative within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX. The
selected operative regains up to 3D3 lost wounds. It cannot
be an operative that the Reanimate rule was used on during
this turning point.
This operative cannot perform this action while within
control range of an enemy operative, or more than once per
turning point.

cards.text:
冥工巨虫战士 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 7" 4+ 7
进攻性防卫：如果这名特工被位于 2" 内的一名敌方
特工残废，在其被移出杀戮区前，掷一枚 D3：若
掷骰结果为 2+，则那名敌方特工受到 1 点伤害。
消耗品构装体：这名特工在您对手的杀戮/消灭任务
中（它被残废以及确认您的起始特工数量时）将被
无视。对于胜利条件和 VP 获取条件中要求特工
“逃脱”“存活”或被敌方特工残废的情况下（它
是否逃脱/存活/被击杀，确认多少特工必须逃脱/存
活/被击杀等情况下）。
无尽巨虫：作为第一个转折点后每个转折点中的战
略计谋，如果您未残废的己方冥工之环战士特工
少于三名，则您可以将就绪且拥有隐匿命令的另一
个己方冥工之环战士特工部署在完全位于己方降
落区内的位置（您可以如常为其选择武器）。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
CANOPTEK MACROCYTE WARRIOR
2 7" 4+ 7
Aggressive Defence: If this operative is incapacitated by an
enemy operative within 2" of it, before this operative is removed
from the killzone, roll one D3: on a 2+, inflict 1 damage on that
enemy operative.
Expendable Construct: This operative is ignored for your
opponent’s kill/elimination op (when it’s incapacitated, and when
determining your starting number of operatives). It’s also ignored
for victory conditions and scoring VPs if either require operatives
to ‘escape’, ‘survive’ or be incapacitated by enemy operatives
(if it escapes/survives/is incapacitated, determining how many
operatives must escape/survive/be incapacitated, etc.).
A Ceaseless Scuttling: As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in
each turning point after the first, if you have less than three
non-incapacitated friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE WARRIOR
operatives, you can set up another one ready and with a Conceal
order wholly within your drop zone (you can select its weapon
options as normal).

APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
CANOPTEK TOMB CRAWLER
2 5" 3+ 18
Weapon Sentinel: Whenever your opponent is selecting a
valid target, if this operative has a Conceal order, it cannot use
Light terrain for cover. While this can allow this operative to be

cards.text:
冥工之环
阵营规则
方尖碑节点矩阵
方尖碑节点是融合了太空死灵科技，能量之核
以及数据流的造物。无论它是从古老墓葬中崛
起，使用本地物质重构还是从口袋维度中相位
传送，这种棱角尖锐的节点可以强化冥工技师
以及其仆役。它们常常会被放至能够连接矩阵
力量的方位，辅佐冥工技师对抗敌人。
作为第一个转折点的战略计谋，将三个己方方尖
碑节点标识放置在完全位于己方领地内。在随后
的每个转折点中，作为战略计谋，您可以将这些
己方方尖碑节点标识各水平移动最多 3"。
己方方尖碑节点标识可以控制没有敌方特工争夺
的其他标识（己方方尖碑节点标识在这个情况下
视为一个己方特工）。如果超过一名玩家尝试使
用方尖碑节点标识控制同一个标识，则没有方尖
碑节点标识能够控制它。
在卡背继续
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FACTION RULE
OBELISK NODE MATRIX
Obelisk nodes are concentrations of Necron technology,
hubs of energy and data streams. Whether raised
up from their sites of ancient burial, formed from
restructured local matter or phased into place from a
pocket dimension, these angular nodes can empower
a Cryptek and their servants. Impelled into positions
where they can connect in a matrix of power, they aid
the Cryptek’s ambitions whilst hampering their foes.
As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT in the first turning point,
place your three OBELISK NODE markers wholly
within your territory. As a STRATEGIC GAMBIT
in each turning point after the first, you can
move each of your OBELISK NODE markers up to
3" horizontally.
Your OBELISK NODE markers control other
markers within 1" of them that no enemy
operatives contest (treat your OBELISK NODE
markers as friendly operatives for this purpose).
If more than one player would use their OBELISK
NODE markers to control the same marker, no
OBELISK NODE markers control it.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
每当一个己方方尖碑节点标识在水平距离上位于
另一个己方方尖碑节点标识 6" 内，这些标识以
及它们之间的区域，以及其上方与下方会形成一
个方尖碑节点矩阵（换言之杀戮区的高度区别对
本效果无关紧要）。如果三个己方方尖碑节点标
识都满足这一条件，便会一并形成一个更大的方
尖碑节点矩阵。
当一名己方冥工之环特工位于己方方尖碑节点
矩阵中时：
• 其数据卡上的武器拥有“精准 1”武器规则。
• 为其 APL 属性增加 1 点（最多提升至 3)。
位于 6" 内会形成方尖碑节点矩阵
超过 6"
形成方尖碑节点

within 6" horizontally of another of your OBELISK
NODE markers, those markers and the area
between them create an OBELISK NODE MATRIX
above and below (in other words, their height
in the killzone is irrelevant). If all three of your
OBELISK NODE markers fulfil this, it creates a
larger combined OBELISK NODE MATRIX.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX:
• Weapons on its datacard have the Accurate 1
weapon rule.
• Add 1 to its APL stat (to a maximum of 3).

cards.text:
冥工之环
战略计谋
超维护盾
量子能量从矩阵中辐射而出，触发了守护协
议。耀眼的绿色光芒吞下实弹，偏转了能量轰
击，同时令敌人困惑不已。
当一名特工射击一名己方冥工之环特工时，若
己方方尖碑节点矩阵造成阻碍，或者那名己方战
士位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内，则您可以重掷任
何结果相同的己方防御骰子（例如结果都为 2 的
骰子）。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
STRATEGY PLOY
HYPERSHIELDING
Quantum energies radiate from the matrix, triggered
by warding protocols. The haze consumes solid shot in
bursts of viridian light and refracts energy blasts, while
its wavering veil confounds targeters.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
CANOPTEK CIRCLE operative, if your OBELISK
NODE MATRIX is intervening, or that friendly
operative is within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX,
you can re-roll any of your defence dice results of
one result (e.g. results of 2).

cards.text:
冥工之环
战略计谋
动力转换增幅
通过弯曲的奥术透镜，现实被压缩成一条条丝
线。光芒闪烁的矩阵增强了太空死灵恐怖的能
量操作技术。
每当一名己方冥工之环特工进行射击时，若己
方方尖碑节点矩阵造成阻碍，或者目标位于己方
方尖碑节点矩阵内，则那名己方特工的武器获
得“无休”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
STRATEGY PLOY
TRANSDYNAMIC AMPLIFICATION
Curving into arcane lenses that compress slivers of
reality, the shimmering matrix magnifies the potency of
the Necrons’ horrifying energistic technologies.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
operative is shooting, if your OBELISK NODE
MATRIX is intervening, or the target is within your
OBELISK NODE MATRIX, that friendly operative’s
weapons have the Ceaseless weapon rule.

cards.text:
冥工之环
战略计谋
冥工重力推斥
太空死灵早已掌握了宇宙的基本力量。在敌人
推进时，方尖碑节点周围涌动的波纹和扭曲涡
流会推走潜在的入侵者。
每次行动限一次，首个将移动进入己方方尖碑节
点矩阵内的敌方特工需额外消耗 1"。请注意，这
意味着如果那名敌方特工没有足够的移动距离
（在它移动结束时），便无法移动进入己方方尖
碑节点矩阵内。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
STRATEGY PLOY
CRYPTOGRAVITIC REPULSION
The universe’s fundamental forces have long been
mastered by the Necrons. As their foes advance,
thudding waves and twisting eddies of gravity amongst
the obelisk nodes repel potential trespassers.
Once per action, the first time an enemy
operative would move within your OBELISK NODE
MATRIX, the distance is treated as an additional
1". Note this means if that enemy operative
doesn’t have sufficient move distance (e.g. it’s at
the end of its move), that operative cannot move
within your OBELISK NODE MATRIX.

cards.text:
冥工之环
战略计谋
吸魂
那些胆敢进入太空死灵区域的生物都会感受到
一股刺骨的无生气息——一种生命力流失的虚
弱感，令他们成为能够轻易猎杀的目标。
每当一名敌方特工位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内，
或当它对位于己方方尖碑节点矩阵内的一名己方
冥工之环特工进行近战或反击时，在那次激活/
反应结束前将那名敌方特工近战武器的两种伤害
属性均减去 1 点（至多减少至 2 点）。请注意，
这意味着如果敌方特工移动穿过己方方尖碑节
点矩阵，便需要将这个修正在那次移动结束时应
用，直至该激活/反应结束。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
STRATEGY PLOY
SOULDRAIN
A lifeless chill creeps into the hearts of those who would
dare to breach the Necrons’ realm – an enervating
leeching of strength and vitality that leaves them
easy prey.
Whenever an enemy operative is within your
OBELISK NODE MATRIX, or whenever it’s fighting
or retaliating against a friendly CANOPTEK
CIRCLE operative that’s within your OBELISK
NODE MATRIX, subtract 1 from both Dmg stats
of that enemy operative’s melee weapons (to a
minimum of 2) until the end of the activation/
counteraction. Note this means if the enemy
operative moves through your OBELISK NODE
MATRIX, apply this change at the end of that
move action until the end of the activation/
counteraction.

cards.text:
冥工之环
交战计谋
护盾闪耀
在一阵闪光中，狙击手的子弹被吞没在微缩维
度中；刀刃穿过了瞬间相位化的物质；时间的
丝线被抹消重写。攻击从未击中过目标，矩阵
能量能够否定一切对太空死灵的微小胜利。
当一枚攻击骰子对一名己方冥工之环特工造成
普通伤害时使用此交战计谋。若己方方尖碑节点
矩阵造成阻碍，或者那名己方特工位于己方方尖
碑节点矩阵内，则无视那次伤害。请注意，是否
造成阻碍的判定将由您的对手判断（即由对手决
定从自己特工底盘的何处划定瞄准线）。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SHIELD FLARE
With a flash, snipers bullets are swallowed in
microdimensions; blades pass through suddenly phased
matter; slivers of time are erased and rewritten, the
strike never connecting after all. The matrix’s energies
deny the Necrons’ verminous foes of the smallest
victory over their betters.
Use this firefight ploy when an attack dice inflicts
Normal Dmg on a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
operative. If your OBELISK NODE MATRIX is
intervening, or that friendly operative is within
your OBELISK NODE MATRIX, ignore that inflicted
damage. Note your opponent determines
intervening (i.e. where on their operative’s base
to draw the targeting lines from).

cards.text:
冥工之环
交战计谋
灵动方尖碑节点
通过某些隐秘指令，若隐若现的方尖碑节点出
现在了新位置中。
当您应当对一个己方特工进行激活或反应时，作
为替代您可以使用此交战计谋，若此，移动任意
数量己方方尖碑节点标识。这些己方方尖碑节点
标识总计最多可以水平移动 6"，并且各自的移
动距离将向上取整到最近的整数（例如您将标识
移动了 1.5"，您便需要将其视为移动了 2"）。例
如，您可以移动单个标识 6"，或是将三个标识各
移动 1"，或者其他总计不超过 6" 的组合。您还
可以使它们移动 0"（从效果上来说相当于跳过激
活）。随后您的对手便正常激活。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
ANIMATE OBELISK NODES
Heeding some hidden command, looming obelisk nodes
surge into new positions of cosmic conjunction.
Use this firefight ploy when it’s your turn to
activate or counteract with a friendly operative.
Move any number of your OBELISK NODE
markers instead. They can move up to 6"
horizontally combined, and distances are always
rounded up to the nearest inch (so if you move
a marker 1.5", it’s treated as moving it 2"). For
example, you could move one marker 6", three
markers 1" each, or any combination that doesn’t
exceed 6" in total. You can also move them 0" (to
effectively skip an activation). In any case, your
opponent activates as normal afterwards.

cards.text:
冥工之环
交战计谋
节点响应
神秘的思维脉冲通过方尖碑节点传递，调整能
量和数据的流动，以应对快速变化的局势。
在一名己方冥工之环特工激活中，执行一次行
动的之前或之后使用此交战计谋。您可以更改
这个转折点中使用的一个战略计谋（如果那个
计谋需要消耗更多 CP，则需要额外消耗相应的
CP），或立即使用一次战略计谋（需要正常消
耗对应 CP）。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
NODAL RESPONSE
Eldritch pulses of artificial thought thrum through the
obelisk nodes as they adjust the flow of energies and
data in response to rapidly changing situations.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly CANOPTEK
CIRCLE operative’s activation, before or after it
performs an action. You can either change one
of the strategy ploys you used during this turning
point (only pay additional CP if that ploy costs
more), or use a strategy ploy now (pay its CP cost
as normal).

cards.text:
冥工之环
交战计谋
可消耗奴仆
这些冥工构装体被设定为会不惜一切代价保
护其主。
当一名己方冥工之环地相技师特工被选为射击
行动的有效目标或成为近战行动的对象时使用此
交战计谋。选择在这名特工 3" 内且可见的另一
名己方冥工之环冥工特工替代成为有效目标（
即便一般情况下它无法成为有效目标）或近战对
象（根据实际情况选择）。如果是近战行动，则
将那个另一名特工在那次行动中视为位于近战特
工的控制范围内。如果这是一次射击行动，那么
其他特工只有在首要目标拥有掩护或遮挡时才能
拥有对应的增益。
在射击行动中，若远程武器拥有“爆炸”或“洪
流”武器规则，本技能没有效果。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SACRIFICIAL THRALL
Canoptek constructs are programmed to shield their
master at all costs.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly CANOPTEK
CIRCLE GEOMANCER operative is selected
as the valid target of a Shoot action or to fight
against during the Fight action. Select one
other friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE CANOPTEK
operative visible to and within 3" of that first
friendly operative to become the valid target or to
be fought against (as appropriate) instead (even
if it wouldn’t normally be valid for this). If it’s the
Fight action, treat that other operative as being
within the fighting operative’s control range for
the duration of that action. If it’s the Shoot action,
that other operative is only in cover or obscured if
the original target was.
This ploy has no effect if it’s the Shoot action
and the ranged weapon has the Blast or Torrent
weapon rule.

cards.text:
冥工之环
阵营装备
矩阵操纵器
随着手指轻抚，老练的地相技师便能使用这个
先进的地相操纵器替代方尖碑节点扩张矩阵。
每场战斗一次，在一名己方冥工之环特工激活
或反应时，您可以使用本规则。若此，直到那次
激活/反应结束时，将一名己方冥工之环地相技
师特工视为己方第四个方尖碑节点标识。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
MATRIX MANIPULATOR
With a flick of their digits, a skilled Geomancer can use
this enhanced geomantic manipulator as a surrogate
obelisk node to extend the matrix.
Once per battle, during a friendly CANOPTEK
CIRCLE operative’s activation or counteraction,
you can use this rule. If you do, until the end
of that activation/counteraction, a friendly
CANOPTEK CIRCLE GEOMANCER operative is
treated as your fourth OBELISK NODE marker.

cards.image: 40-02-阵营装备-觉醒的方尖碑节点.png
cards.text:
冥工之环
阵营装备
觉醒的方尖碑节点
这些激活的方尖碑节点早已被放置于此，吸收
了大量本地数据，随时准备为其控制者提供关
键信息。
在揭示装备选项后，掷一枚 D3，你可以在战
斗中消耗 0CP 使用“灵动方尖碑节点”交战策
略，以此方式使用的次数等于掷骰结果。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
AWAKENED OBELISK NODES
Seeded into place and activated long ago, these obelisk
nodes have absorbed huge stores of local data, ready to
gift their controller with a superior edge when the time
is right.
After revealing this equipment option, roll one D3.
You can use the Animate Obelisk Nodes firefight
ploy for 0CP a number of times during the battle
equal to the result.

cards.text:
冥工之环
阵营装备
纳米甲虫闸
这件小型设备似乎释放出了如同鬼影般的蒸
汽。实际上，这团云雾由能够修补活体金属的
微型修复构装体组成。
每当一名己方冥工之环特工激活时，它便恢复
最多 D3 点失去的耐伤。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
NANOSCARAB CASKETS
These small devices appear to release wisps of spectral
vapour. In truth, they are clouds of tiny repair constructs
that seal rents in living metal.
Whenever a friendly CANOPTEK
CIRCLE operative is activated, it regains up to
D3 lost wounds.

cards.text:
冥工之环
阵营装备
移相器
持有者的形体在维度之间如同幽灵般闪烁着，
使得敌人难以命中。
每个转折点一次，当一名特工对一名己方冥工之
环地相技师特工进行射击时，在掷防御骰步骤
开始时，您可以使用这个规则。若此，在那次流
程结束前将“穿刺”武器规则的 X 值降低 1 点，
请注意，这意味着“穿刺 1 ”将被无视。
cards.text_en:
CANOPTEK CIRCLE
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PHASE SHIFTER
The bearer’s form flits between dimensions like a
phantom, rendering it exceedingly difficult to land a
telling blow upon them.
Once per turning point, when an operative
is shooting a friendly CANOPTEK CIRCLE
GEOMANCER operative, at the start of the Roll
Defence Dice step, you can use this rule. If you
do, worsen the x of the Piercing weapon rule by 1
(if any) until the end of that sequence. Note that
Piercing 1 would therefore be ignored.
